Draw one icon in pure white flat ink (#FFFFFF) on a fully transparent background, in exactly the style of the attached

no frame. Invented shapes only. The icon shows:

Paint: A prosthetic arm with a small cut-power mark.

STYLE CLARIFICATION: this is a generic condition SIGN. NO Wick, no screen head, no mascot capelet or lantern chest. Only the named subject, 2 interior cuts at most, bold clear silhouette. Translate any light/glow into a single white tick or ray; never gray, gradients or bloom.
